Spade | Multiple Engineering, AI/ML Data Science, and Revenue roles| HYBRID NYC or REMOTE (US/CAN) | $135-240K+ (depending on role/level) + equity

Spade helps banks and fintechs unlock the value in their own transaction data.

We're looking for extraordinary builders to play a foundational role in a company designed for scale:

  - Senior Platform Security Engineer (Remote US/CAN or NYC)

  - Backend Engineer (Remote US/CAN or NYC)

  - Fullstack Engineer (NYC)

  - Data Scientist - AI/ML (NYC)

  - Product Performance Analyst (NYC)

  - Account Executive - Enterprise, Fintech (NYC)

  - Product Marketing Manager (NYC)
We're well-funded by top investors (YC/a16z/OAK), and known for building intentional, inclusive culture. We offer competitive compensation (salary + equity) and comprehensive benefits. NYC roles are hybrid (2 days/week in our dog-friendly Flatiron office).

If interested, please apply here (https://spade.com/careers/) and mention this post.
